rows.claim: DaocNavMesh: nifs.csv (ID->filename) + fixtures.csv (nif_id, XYZ, rotation, scale, collision, unique_id) -> translation x rotation x scale x zone offset -> WORLD MATRIX -> load NIF
rows.observation: nifs[stoi(csv[i][0])]=csv[i][2] (L87). fixtures: row[3..5]=XYZ, row[11]=on-ground, row[7]=scale/100, row[6]=angle, row[15..18]=axis-angle, row[0]=id, row[1]=nif_id, row[8]=collide, row[9]=radius, row[14]=unique_id (L94-114). World matrix per fixture = T x R x S (L124-127), scale Y NEGATED; NIF loaded via Niflib::ReadNifTree (L204). ORDER CORRECTION: zone offset is applied SEPARATELY at traversal as the OUTERMOST pre-multiplication (L221: translate(offset_x*8192, offset_y*8192, 0); L243: world * fix.world) => final = T_zone x (T x R x S), NOT a trailing factor after scale.
rows.limitation: Claimed component list confirmed; the claimed composition ORDER ('x zone offset' as trailing term) does NOT match the code - the substance stands, order corrected. DAoC format != Entropia format.
rows.relevance_to_eu935: HYPOTHETICAL: T x R x S with zone offset at traversal is a SEARCH PATTERN for NetImmerse-era static instance transform composition; NOT transferable semantics.

rows.claim: OpenDAoC-BuildNav independently reads fixtures.csv (nifid, XYZ, rotation, scale) and builds the transform BEFORE adding the NIF
rows.observation: L184 reads fixtures.csv; L195-224 parses fixture[0..18] (same grammar as B1); L239-246 builds worldMatrix = I; *= CreateScale(scale,-scale,scale); *= axis-angle/rotZ; *= CreateTranslation(xyz + Zone.OffsetVector) BEFORE AddModelToObj (L269). Zone offset added INTO the translation vector (vs DaocNavMesh pre-multiplication - same effect, different mechanism).
rows.limitation: BuildNav is a DECLARED FORK of thekroko/uthgard-opensource buildnav (README) - not first-hand; see B5. DAoC format != Entropia.
rows.relevance_to_eu935: HYPOTHETICAL: independent confirmation of the same fixture grammar + transform-before-attach pipeline as a SEARCH PATTERN.

rows.claim: Kinship: do the DAoC repos share code (fork/copy)? Which are NOT independent sources?
rows.source: All four repos + thekroko/uthgard-opensource (GitHub API + code inspection, 2026-09-13)
rows.observation: NO GitHub fork relationship among the four (C# 2014-17 SharpDX+Niflib.NET; C++20 2024 glm+own Niflib; C# 2025 System.Numerics+own NiFile; C++/Qt 2010 MagickWand). OpenDAoC-BuildNav is a DECLARED FORK of thekroko/uthgard-opensource pathing/buildnav (README verbatim; upstream verified as 'Portions of Uthgard - a Dawn Of Light freeshard'). BuildNav = ONE lineage with Uthgard, NOT a copy of MapCreator. Agreement on non-obvious field layout = mutual corroboration of the DAoC format reading; knowledge genealogy (later author learning from earlier repo) cannot be excluded.
rows.limitation: Based on READMEs/metadata/code inspection, not a full provenance audit. Corroboration concerns the DAoC client format only.
rows.relevance_to_eu935: HYPOTHETICAL: calibrates the independent weight of the DAoC precedent as a RESEARCH PATTERN (3 lineages + 1 Uthgard-BuildNav lineage); zero weight as Entropia evidence.

rows.claim: Dawn of Light: NPC-creation packet contains Heading->Z->X->Y->Model (world transform + model ID runtime). Which object classes are handled?
rows.source: Dawn-of-Light/DOLSharp commit 776619f88d2d5ce52f09ab956194fd519a41f985 (2026-06-04), GameServer/packets/Server/PacketLib168.cs L1038-1065 (SendNPCCreate), IPacketLib.cs L120-127
rows.observation: NPCCreate = 0xDA; packet: ObjectID, speed, Heading, Z, X, Y, speedZ, Model, Size, Level, flags, name, guild (L1058-1065) - claimed sequence confirmed verbatim. CREATE CENSUS: SendNPCCreate(GameNPC) 0xDA; SendObjectCreate(GameObject) 0xD9 (GameStaticItem/GameKeepBanner/GameStaticItemTimed/WorldInventoryItem/IDoor); SendPlayerCreate 0xD4; SendMovingObjectCreate 0x12; SendHouse(House) HouseCreate=0xD1 - player HOUSING. Static city buildings NOT in the server packet family (DAoC static world is client-side fixtures.csv - group B).
rows.limitation: EMULATOR reimplementation of DAoC protocol - evidence of what a DAoC-compatible server sends, not Mythic's original code. Precedent for NPC/dynamic/housing network placement; NOT evidence that static cities are network-placed (in DAoC they are not).
rows.relevance_to_eu935: HYPOTHETICAL: {transform + model ID} packet grammar is the SEARCH PATTERN for EU935 runtime create-object - applicable to DYNAMIC entities; explicitly NOT a static-building precedent.

rows.claim: (CRITICAL trap) Establish from CODE what F_CREATE_STATIC actually creates - does the name prove city placement?
rows.source: WarEmu code, same commit as D2a (GameObject.cs, GameObject_spawn.cs, World/Objects census)
rows.observation: GameObject : Unit is the ONLY sender of F_CREATE_STATIC; class carries LOOT generation, QUEST interaction (QUEST_USE_GO), Tok unlocks, Faction/Rank/Level from Spawn.Proto, scripts; embedded real-packet hex comment decodes to 'Empire Bar Door'. Spawn source = emulator WORLD DATABASE (GameObject_spawn : DataObject, TableName='gameobject_spawns', DatabaseName='World'). Census: Object->GameObject/Door(empty)/ChapterObject/PQuestObject/Item; Unit->Creature/Player. CODE SHOWS: F_CREATE_STATIC creates DB-driven INTERACTIVE objects (doors, lootable props, quest objects). CODE DOES NOT SHOW: any static-city geometry path; name 'STATIC' = non-monster interactive object; no evidence WAR authored static world comes from the server.
rows.limitation: Conclusive for the WarEmu codebase ONLY; nothing about WAR's original server (not public).
rows.relevance_to_eu935: HYPOTHETICAL but DECISIVE for EU935 direction: network-create precedent covers DYNAMIC/interactive entities (+DAoC housing); does NOT support network-first for authored static cities - consistent with DAoC client-side fixtures.csv and ERRATA_R2 H_CLIENT-priority-as-research-direction.
